about: The Guard App's call-style ring, as an executable table (GUARD_RING_DESIGN section 7.9). JUnit runs every row against the Kotlin (android/src/test), jest checks the table is well formed and that every decision and screen it names exists in the Kotlin, and gate:ring-native reads it too. A row is a promise: change the table and the code together, never one of them.
